channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: County mails 2026 decals for convenience centers
item.description: Wilson County Solid Waste is replacing pink hang tags with green windshield decals for residents in unincorporated areas, changing how and when permits are issued.

item.title: Wilson Energy preparing for long-term future
item.description: Wilson Energy detailed a decades-long plan to upgrade lines, substations and infrastructure, prepare for big industrial loads and eventually build a new countywide transmission loop.

item.title: Down to Business: The Lines Den is a reader’s delight
item.description: At The Lines Den, downtown Wilson’s new bookstore, owner Lisa Malone keeps the former Novel Nest space thriving with used books and plans to add more new releases.

item.title: Congressional Black Caucas PAC endorses Smith for U.S. Congress
item.description: Congressional Black Caucus PAC endorsed Raymond Smith Jr. in the U.S. Congressional District 3 race, backing his bid against fellow Democrat Allison Jaslow ahead of the March primary.

item.title: New fire chief focusing on Wilson’s growth
item.description: New Wilson Fire/Rescue Chief Ray Enoch is planning new stations and staffing to keep pace with the city’s rapid growth while strengthening community ties and response times.

item.title: Area Calendar, Feb. 9-10, 2026
item.description: Area sports for Feb. 9-10: full slate of local high school basketball, CPIC tournament quarterfinals and Barton home baseball vs. Catawba.

item.title: Add ‘the Trimble game’ to the Duke-Carolina classics
item.description: Seth Trimble’s corner 3 with 0.04 seconds left capped North Carolina’s rally from 13 down to beat No. 4 Duke 71-69 in Chapel Hill, adding a new “Trimble game” to the rivalry’s lore.

item.title: BC women handle King with ease, 71-61
item.description: Barton women roll past King 71-61 for a third straight win, led by Layne Sleight’s 17 points, Lauren Mingo’s 14-point, 13-rebound double-double and a 44-31 edge on the glass to stay in the Conference Carolinas race.

item.title: Bulldogs turn back Tornado to stop skid
item.description: Barton men snap three-game skid as Sean Quick-Streeter and Trey Fields score 23 each in an 89-74 win over King, ending the Tornado’s three-game streak in Conference Carolinas play.

item.title: BARTON ROUNDUP: Bulldogs open season with doubleheader sweep of VU
item.description: Barton softball opens 2026 with run-rule sweep of Virginia Union as Makenzie Burroughs stars, while baseball earns first win for new coach and men’s lacrosse, volleyball fall in tight home openers.
